title: GET https://reforger.armaplatform.com/api/news?take=<n>
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13 by the game client - not by the dedicated server - when the client was run behind the proxy: 200 with six items. The dedicated server fetches /api/popup from the same host instead, so this belongs to the client's half of the surface, which is otherwise uncaptured. The fields match the NewsFeedItem class the binary carries.

items.description: The newest items, in the order the game shows them. `take` in the query string is the count, and six were asked for and returned.

newsItem.description: One news entry as the launcher-style feed shows it: {"date":"24 September 2026","category":"Modding","slug":"...","title":"...","coverImage":{"src":"..."},"fullUrl":"..."}.

date.description: A display date, not ISO: `24 September 2026` in the capture.

excerpt.description: A short plain-text summary, 87 characters in the captured item.

category.description: Observed: Modding. A free string here; the categories are the publisher's, not the engine's.

slug.description: The URL slug of the article.

src.description: A URL, 59 characters in the captured item.

fullUrl.description: Where the game opens the article - a URL on the platform, 66 characters in the capture.
